title: Accuracy parameter and inverse power identity
statement: For every natural number $k$, let $\eta_k$ be the rational number $2^{-(k+2)}$, viewed as the first coordinate of the learning parameter defined from $k$. Then, as real numbers, $$(2^{-1})^k=4\eta_k.$$
hypotheses_covered: $\eta_k$ is the first coordinate of the parameter defined as $2^{-(k+2)}$
